about: The seeded demo leads (app/seed/leads.py), read before Gemini has enriched them, so only the contact and device rules speak. Scores start at 100: 80 or more is clear, 50 to 79 review, under 50 high risk. Michael Chen is a genuine lead but is left out: M. Chen reuses Michael's phone, so the shared-contact rule (T04) rightly flags both sides of the pair for review.

cases.why: A mailinator.com email (T01, -25), a phone without a country code (T02, -10) and three more leads on the same device within half an hour (T05, -25) leave 40: high risk.
Jordan Lee is one of four leads on device dev-ring-0001 within half an hour (T05, -25) and writes from yopmail.com (T01, -25): 50, flagged for review.
M. Chen gives a new email but Michael Chen's phone number, +16175550142, which another lead already gave (T04, -25): 75, flagged for review.
An ordinary example.com email, a valid +1 phone, a device no other lead uses and contact details no other lead shares: no rule applies, so 100 and clear.
